description.value: Rain or Shine is a beloved Vancouver homemade ice cream chain making small-batch flavours with locally sourced BC ingredients, including custom-formula dairy from Birchwood Dairy Farm in Abbotsford. The UBC location sits on University Boulevard at the edge of campus, placing it directly on a popular cycling corridor near Pacific Spirit Regional Park trails. A rotating seasonal menu complements permanent flavours, with dedicated vegan and gluten-free options throughout.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 63m; rack at 67m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 75m; stands (4 spaces) at 81m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies the UBC location (6001 University Boulevard) of a multi-location Vancouver ice cream chain; the website contact page explicitly lists 'UBC 6001 University Boulevard' with phone 604.620.2004, confirming the OSM address. Vegan and gluten-free options are confirmed by both the OSM tag diet:vegan=yes and multiple website menu entries labelling specific items vegan or gluten-free. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; 604.620.2004 was sourced from the website contact page for the UBC location specifically.
This is a three-location chain (UBC, Cambie, Kitsilano); this OSM record and listing represent the UBC location only — other locations should be treated as separate candidates.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established local chain at a UBC campus location on a popular cycling corridor; vegan and GF options confirmed; a natural refreshment stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Numerous flavours are also labelled 'Gluten free. Egg free.'
